classification.difficultyReason: Read two suitable points from a truncated graph, calculate their slope, then use that supplied part-a result and one point to recover the unseen intercept and equation.

content.prompt:
Kaito measured the height ($h$), in cm, of a bean seedling each week ($w$) from week 3 to week 8.

He created a scatterplot and constructed a line of best fit to model the relationship between the week and the height of the seedling.

spec.description: Week and height scatterplot with black circular markers, major grid, 2 cm vertical subdivisions and the supplied line of best fit. Axes are truncated so the y-intercept is not shown.
spec.mathematics: Week axis 2-9; height axis 10-50 cm. The line passes through the grid intersections (3,18) and (8,38), giving h=4w+6. Data point positions are chosen scatter values near the line.
spec.answerVisibility: The scatterplot and line are always visible. The derived gradient and equation appear only in answers.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Determine the gradient of the line of best fit.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{38-18}{8-3}\\&=4\end{aligned}$$
The units of the gradient are cm per week.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Determine the equation of the line of best fit.
